status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY - Italy was excluded entirely from fitting and evaluation in this robustness test
reason: Read-only audit (see conversation) found Italy is a single site (institution_id 600), enrolled only 2015-2016, using a non-standard followup_1-4 visit-labeling scheme (vs month_3-month_96 elsewhere), with ~3x longer visit gaps (mean 350 vs ~110-118 days elsewhere) and a site-concentrated same-day-duplicate-record pattern (39 rows / 20 patients) that the pipeline's existing, pre-documented zero/negative-time-gap filter removes. This produces an anomalous response-class distribution (0 occurrences of partial_response or stable_disease as a Vt+1 outcome, a 78.7% raw 'improvement' rate vs 15-20% elsewhere) that reflects assessment sparsity/density, not a coding bug and not necessarily a genuine country-level practice-pattern difference in treatment response.

pairing.note: all 20 dropped pairs traced to patients with same-day duplicate valid-response records, unique to Italy in this dataset

recommendation: Do not merge into a 'non-US' aggregate or treat this rate as comparable to Spain/Canada/US without further investigation of the underlying visit-schedule difference.
